title: Nuka Engineering
body:
Lore-Friendly Automation Addon for Nukacraft.

Dependencies:
- Nukacraft
Reccomended Mods:
- Immersive Engineering is highly reccomended. The machines in Nuka Engineering have been designed with the power transmission and conveyors assemblies of Immersive Engineering in mind.

Content:
Fusion Core / Generator Overhaul:
- Nuclear Generators now accept fusion cores and will generate power with a core inserted. Attach a connector / cable to the output port on the top of the generator to extract power.
- Nuclear Generators now render empty when no fusion core is inserted.
- Naturally spawning Nuclear Generators now have a 20% chance to spawn with a fusion core inserted between 30% and 90% charge.
- Nuclear Generators are now craftable at a workbench.

Ammunition Press:
- Mass produce Nukacraft ammo with the Ammunition Press.
- Provide power into the top of the machine.
- Select a ammo type from the list and lock it in. You can only craft one type of ammo at a time.
- Insert items either manually or via conveyor into the back.
- Crafted ammo will be ejected onto the output conveyor.
- All ammo recipes are the same as they are seen in the workbench.
